tests.deferred: A callback that the browser still calls after it was taken back is shown by the native controller tests, with a scheduler that keeps cancelled tasks. The page scheduler frees a taken-back closure, so the real page cannot call one. Pause leaves a seek that is waiting alone is also native: the page has no way to pause while a seek is waiting, since a seek stops playback
